title: GTA6 Rival? Ambitious PS5 Open World Ananta Dated
description: Discover the latest hands-on impressions of the ambitious anime open world game Ananta, launching on January 15th, just weeks after GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## An Ambitious PS5 Open World Set to Launch Alongside GTA 6

As the current console generation marches toward its later stages, players always hope for titles that push hardware to its absolute limits. Recently, hands-on time with the remarkable anime open world game *Ananta* has turned heads across the gaming community, with media outlets expressing disbelief that such an ambitious project is actually real.

### A Massive Open World Sandbox Launching in January 2026

According to reports from Push Square, *Ananta* is officially scheduled to launch on 15th January. What makes this release window particularly fascinating is that it arrives just weeks after the equally impressive *GTA 6*. This tight scheduling sets up an extraordinarily exciting end to the PS5 generation for fans of urban sandboxes and open-world exploration.

### Pushing the PS5 Generation to Its Limits

While *Ananta* adopts a striking anime art style that contrasts sharply with the gritty realism of Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece, both games share a commitment to delivering massive, immersive urban environments. Releasing so close to *GTA 6* is a bold move, but it highlights the developers' confidence in the project's unique appeal. For PS5 owners, having two colossal open-world experiences back-to-back promises an unforgettable start to the year.

## Editor's Take

Launching an ambitious open-world game just weeks after *GTA 6* takes immense bravery. *Ananta* doing just that on January 15th, 2026, proves its developers have serious confidence. Together, they create a thrilling finale for the PS5's urban sandbox genre.
